text:
mara: Quick mock uploaded — consolidating Region / Encryption / Retention into a compact "crypto matrix" on the workspace settings page. link: https://figma.com/file/abc123  
mara: TL;DR: want feedback on visual hierarchy, microcopy (esp. KMS/owner language), and keyboard/ARIA behavior. :eyes:  
julian: Nice layout. A11y concern: screen readers will read a dense table — I'd make each row a role=group with a visible header + hidden labels for each control. Example pattern: <div role="group" aria-labelledby="row-region-1">... 
julian: Also suggest header ordering: Region → Encryption → Retention (logical for users choosing where data lives first). 
ash: Copy nit: prefer "Encrypted (customer key)" over "BYOK" — BYOK is jargon. Maybe: "Encryption: Encrypted — Key owner: Customer" with a tooltip "Customer-managed key (BYOK). Learn more". 
ash: For status verbs, use consistent tense in audit logs: "Key rotated" vs "Key rotation" — pick one. I vote for past-tense events ("rotated"). 
sean: Retention label: use "Retention period" not "TTL". And show selector summary like "30 days" inline. Also if region has a fallback, show subtle hint: "(fallback: us-east-1)" so users know behavior on unsupported combos. 
designbot: Uploaded updated mock with aria-group changes and new copy: https://figma.com/file/abc123?node-id=45 :white_check_mark: 
security-bot: Audit log copy suggestion: prefer full-context messages. e.g. "KMS key rotated for workspace 'research' by @jdoe at 2024-03-12T15:02Z" rather than terse tokens. Keeps logs searchable. 
mara: Agree on all. Two remaining questions: 1) Should the key owner label be "Key owner" or "Key managed by"? 2) For keyboard nav, should each row be tabbable or should we group controls so Tab cycles through groups first? :thinking: 
julian: I prefer "Key owner" (noun) — shorter and easier to scan. For keyboard nav, group first — Tab to group, then arrow keys to move within row. Document pattern in dev notes. 
ash: UX microcopy for tooltip link: "How customer-managed keys work". Keep link text consistent with support pages. 
mara: Thanks — I'll update the mock and add a short SR sample for screen readers (@julian can you add the sample narration?). Aiming to ship copy + aria changes in the next design sweep, deadline EOD tomorrow. 
sean: Will coordinate with product docs for the retention/fallback language. :+1:
